# Candidate Assessment: DOC_resume_ninety vs. DOC_posting_ten_five

## Mandatory Requirements

| # | Requirement | Résumé | Match |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | Languages: Python | ✅ |
| 2 | SQL | Languages: SQL | ✅ |
| 3 | Linux administration | Platform: Linux administration | ✅ |
| 4 | Git | Platform: Git | ✅ |
| 5 | REST API design | Services: REST API design | ✅ |
| 6 | Unit testing | Services: unit testing | ✅ |
| 7 | CI pipelines | Services: CI pipelines | ✅ |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | Infrastructure: all five listed | ✅ |
| 9 | Kafka | Streaming: Kafka | ✅ |
| 10 | GraphQL | Not listed | ❌ |

**Mandatory match: 9 of 10 = 90%**

Item 8 bundles five technologies into one numbered requirement. If each technology is counted separately, the result is 13 of 14 (≈92.9%). Either way, the result clears the 85% threshold, so the outcome doesn't depend on which way you count.

## Gap
- **GraphQL** is the only unmet mandatory requirement. The candidate's REST API design experience is related, but the résumé shows no direct GraphQL experience.

## Nice-to-Have (for reference only)
The résumé lists none of these: Grafana, Prometheus, technical writing, mentoring, or public speaking. As you specified, this does not affect the outcome.

## Outcome
**Proceed.** The mandatory match of 90% exceeds the 85% threshold. You may want to ask about GraphQL exposure in the next stage, since it's the one mandatory gap.
